item.title: [News] Signify Awarded EcoVadis Platinum Medal with Its Highest-Ever Score of 88
item.description: Signify, the world leader in lighting, has been awarded an EcoVadis Platinum medal with an overall score of 88 out of 100, its highest score to date. Signify also received 100 out of 100 in the Environment theme. The Platinum medal places Signify among the top 1% of companies rated by EcoVadis during the preceding 12 months and marks the company's seventh consecutive year of Platinum recognition.
